'''South Massir''' is a sub-continent located in the southern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[Bay of Rimi]] and [[Haanian Ocean]] to the south, [[North Massir]] and [[West Mahea]] to the north, [[West Massir]] to the west and the [[Ubrana Sea]] and [[Trayd Cren Sea]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|6,173,029|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 7th largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 156,362,340 as of 1765, making it also the 16th largest sub-continent by population.
